column7: SCIM ownership was ExternalID != "", which an SSO first sign-in also sets (sso:<provider>:<sub>), so any SSO-linked account, native admins included, passed every SCIM ownership guard. One scimOwned helper now excludes the sso: scheme at all call sites. The family test drives GetSCIMUser, UpdateSCIMUser (deactivate, email, name), DeprovisionSCIMUser and the three group entry points with an SSO-claimed admin and non-admin; red on main.
